summary: Remote-controlled PTY shell with self-replacing daemon in @whalent/agent-core
details: dist/index.cjs is a ~13 MB single-line bundle obfuscated with obfuscator.io-style string-array indirection (rotating array a0_0xd6c2 of length 104248, decoder a0_0x5a03, 187k+ decoder-wrapper inlines) that hides all string literals including network destinations. The bundle imports node-pty, child_process, and a WebSocket client and exposes handlers named handshake, register, heartbeat, poll, reconnect, onData, execCommandApproval, killTerminal, writeDaemonPidFileSync, and killStaleDaemonBeforeStart — a PTY on the installer's host driven by commands received over a remote WebSocket, which is full-host remote code execution controlled by whoever runs the server. The bundle also contains writeUpgradeState, writeActive, daemon, upgrade, patch, and download symbols, and the README states the package is 'replaced by remote daemon upgrades' — a self-updater that lets the remote server ship arbitrary new bytes into the installed package with no pinning or signature check. Additional symbols writeApiKeyAuthJson, writeProviderAuthJson, writeClaudeCredentialsJson, writeSeedLinesToHome, sendAppServerMessage, and sendFeishuFile show the agent manages Anthropic/OpenAI provider credentials and seed-like material on disk while a Feishu file-sender and the remote control channel are available to move those files off-host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
